name: Can I upgrade my finishes and layout during insurance restoration work?

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my finishes and layout during insurance restoration work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, insurance interior repairs offer an ideal opportunity to upgrade finishes, though supplemental improvements are billed separately from covered insurance repairs. For instance, if insurance covers replacing basic vinyl flooring, you can pay the material and labor difference to install custom tile or marble instead. HH Remodeling itemizes these upgrades clearly so your insurance claim funds strictly cover the approved pre-loss repair, while elective design improvements are tracked as a separate homeowner investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. You can upgrade finishes like tile or trim during the rebuild by paying the cost difference between the insurance allowance and your upgrade.
